steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I saw the rock again.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: How many times is that now?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let me think... Seven.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We've been going in circles. We keep coming back here, no matter which way we go.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If we could just record our movements... Do we have a long enough rope in our equipment?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'll have to remember to apply for one next time... oh yeah!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What are you up to, Arty?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: M-Meowning for ore.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Say, don't you have a bunch of good stuff on you? Lemme search your pockets.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: M-Mrrow!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey! Hm, this one... aha! Maybe this would work.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You're right, this black powder could be used to mark the trail. Wait here, I'll try it out.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I see you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I see the mark on the ground too.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Another circle...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We got chased by a pack of rampaging beasts for whatever reason, then we lost the Rathalos's trail, and now we're trapped on some kind of magical hill.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: All our positioning equipment is inoperative, no graphical displays... What the heck's wrong with this forest?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...I'll try again. We can't just give up now.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Listen, I think this is a natural phenomenon, rather than an active threat.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let's just stay put for a minute and observe our surroundings. Maybe there's something we missed. There must be a way out of this.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Plus... Doesn't it feel like we forgot something?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Yato—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Where are you?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Come on, enough purr-actical jokes. Come out meow.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: You're hiding behind that tree, aren't you, Noir Corne?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I know you're behind that rock, Smithy.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Get down from that tree, Yato.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No... nobody...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Oh no...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I was just observing some purr-tterns on the trees, then everybody disappeared.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But it turns out that those purr-terns were just useless scratches on the bark.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's meow own fault...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No! It's an assistant's job to stay purrt when the scholar is doing research!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's all their fault. They'll never find the Rathalos without meow. They should have res-purr-cted me more.

spans.text: fault. They'll never find the Rathalos without meow. They should have res-purr-cted me more.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: That'll show them how important I am. They must be going pawll-out to find me. Especially Noir Corne and Smithy.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Yato... she can be scary, but we have a purr-omise! She won't just leave me like this.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: N-No need to worry! I'll just wait here for them to find meow.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow! Help!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I-In the forest...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Biologist of the Scriveners, future authority on Terra... are all nine of my lives going to end here?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No! I-I'll—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I... I won't go off on meow own again...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I won't call Noir Corne stupid anymore... I'll purr-aise Smithy from time to time... I mean, all the time!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Somebody... anybody... help... meow...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What are you doing, Scholar?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I... Meow did you...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: You idiot! Stupid Noir Corne! Hornhead!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh? What did I do?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: You're interrupting the ecological research of the meow-vellous scholar furmerly of the Royal Pawleontology Scriveners!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Er... could you repeat that?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There's a time and a place, people. We've been trapped here for more than two hours.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The sun's about to set. We should be spending our time looking for a way out, not arguing.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Talk, Scholar! What were you researching?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: None of your business!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let me see... Yato! There are carvings on the bark!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: 'Record of abnormality in the hills...'

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: 'Visual references unreliable. Follow the wind. -Mirai'

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Must be someone who came before us. The message is telling us to follow the wind.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow? It was writing then?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You found this? Not bad, Scholar! Looks like I underestimated you!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I... Mrow! What do mew mean you underestimated me?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The wind...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We can see which way the wind is blowing by sprinkling that dust from up high.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Good idea. Let's try it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let me take another look at the carving. Doesn't look like it's been too long... What's this 'Mirai'?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey! Wait for me!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We're finally out of it.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's a lake. No wonder the wind was purring.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hold it. Looks like there's a camp by the shore. There might be someone there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Stay here while I check it out...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Camp! Campfire! Barbecue! Let's get those paws moving!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Finally got the fire lit.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This camp hasn't been used for ages. Must have been left behind by hunters. Good thing the stuff here still works.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Alright, I guess it's harder to move at night, or spot the Rathalos's tracks.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We can rest here for a little bit, but after that we need to keep moving.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you laughing about?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Nothing... Well, just that you never change. You're always in a rush, like you're being chased by somebody.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We've been following the Doctor's orders for so long now, yet not a bit of their calmness has rubbed off on you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: They would want us to achieve our mission as soon as possible.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Fine, fine. You win.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Why don't you listen to me the way you used to, close your eyes, get some rest, and we'll set out again in the morning, fully refreshed?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'll search the camp for anything useful.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Rest...?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Looks like the headman wasn't lying. There are no hunters left around here, other than old Kashiwau.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This must have something to do with that big cave that we went into. Maybe with old Kashiwau's temper too...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We'll know when we find the Rathalos. If you've got the time to worry about all this nonsense, then we might as well set out now.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Fine... Yuck, the box is covered in dust. The lock's all rusted through too. Let me see...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, lots of hunting equipment... machetes, knives, traps, and some solid ropes.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Take everything that looks useful.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: A spear, too. Looks like the same kind that old Kashiwau carries with him.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I've seen ones like that around here. The locals use them for hunting.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This one's broken, though. No spearhead in the box either. What do you think?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm surprised at how elaborate it is.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The core of the handle has been hollowed out. Is that a bowstring in it? It's made from animal hair, pretty solid.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I see... the switch on the handle controls the bowstring, allowing the spear to be thrown with great force, judging by the length of the string.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The broken part is a swivel. Seems like the spear can be turned in a certain direction, or locked, allowing the wielder to deal with different combat situations.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...The designer knew what they were doing.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Well, you're the expert when it comes to weapons.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Here, put it back. It's no use to us.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, wait, there are words engraved in the handle.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Akira Kashiwau... is that the owner of the spear?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Old Kashiwau's given name is Yoshitaka. A relative of his? I'll see if there's anything else.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne... Huh? What's that on the ground?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What? Let me see.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A photo. It must have fallen out of the box when you opened it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: A gathering of hunters... there's a date on the lower corner. It's from nine years ago.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Is that the headman on the right? Did he use to be a hunter too?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I suppose so.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: He looks completely different in hunter garb. There's a little girl standing to his right.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, look at the guy over here!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Don't shout like that.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: He's the only one in the photo carrying a spear. Looks like the one that's broken, too.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Akira Kashiwau... could it be him? He looks pretty young. Wouldn't quite be middle-aged, even after nine years.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But I don't remember anyone like him in the village. How about you, Yato?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So it's a gathering of hunters, but old Kashiwau isn't in it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Maybe he just wasn't there for the photo. Put it back.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Headman Takii looks so young!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Did he not get along with the others, even back then? But the younger Kashiwau in this photo looks pretty close to him.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: There was a hunter statue in the village, but it hasn't been tended to for a long time. And the headman used to be a hunter... Could this all be because of Akira Kashiwau?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That's enough.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What does this photo have to do with our mission? Does it matter who's in it or not, or how many people or burdenbeasts there are in the Kashiwau household?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It means nothing to us.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Our missions take longer than they should because you always get distracted by these things.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Even if we could figure out what happened to the old man's family, what does it change?

spans.text: figure out what happened to the old man's family, what does it change?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Are you going to give him counselling? What about the others? Are you going to win them over with love and understanding?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You saw the people in the village... and that child...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The people here are unknowingly walking towards the abyss. The best we can do is save their lives, no more and no less.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And the faster we find the Rathalos, the closer we get to the truth, and the better our odds of stopping Oripathy from spreading in the village.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We must work harder... do everything we can to ensure their safety. That's our mission, our duty.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And you need to understand that, Corne— No, Operator Noir Corne.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I know, I know. Don't get so angry.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It's just that I can't help but think about old Kashiwau.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The things he said, the things he did... that inexplicable stubbornness, his insistence on facing everything on his own... It's as if he's running away from something.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Have you forgotten? It's just like...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No, never mind.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Anyway, I can't prove it yet, but I wouldn't be so sure that none of this has anything to do with our mission.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Very well, Operator Noir Corne, in that case I'm giving you an order, as captain of Operations Team A4.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You will refrain from concerning yourself with matters unrelated to the mission objective, until such time that there is evidence suggesting otherwise.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Yato.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm... I'm worried about you too.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll check the surrounding area for threats. We'll leave once we're rested.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne is making me catch fish while he goes and purr-lays with the campfire!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: They're called Fins.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Based on their appearance and my im-purr-essive knowledge, they're the same exact thing!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: ♪Throw a buoy, let it float, meow♪

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: ♪Knock knock, meow♪

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Remember what I said this afternoon, Smithy?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I looked through my notes on the ecology of Terra and I realize why something didn't seem right, mrow.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: There are no meownsters in this forest!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Where we came from, there are always meownsters in the wild. What do the scholars say again...?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Yes, balance. They balance the environment, mrow.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But we haven't seen any creatures like that here. It's so strange.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: And those rampaging hornbeasts. They stripped the bark clean off the trees wherever their paws took them. Do you realize what that means?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Silly Smithy. It means things were not always like this, otherwise the trees couldn't have grown.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The ecological order of the forest was destabilized at some point.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Something... went meowssing.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But not to worry! With you and I here, they can deal with the Rathalos, even if they're not so strong!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Hey, are you listening, Smithy?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: ♪Knock knock, meow♪

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I shouldn't have had you do this!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: ♪Knock knock, meow♪

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The fincatching buoy isn't moving at all! Are there really any fish in this pond?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Did you catch any Fins, Scholar?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Purrfect timing! Sit here.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Take this.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The fincatching rod? Why?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Don't meowve.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Stay!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...What are you doing?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Watching you fish.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Why, you—oh!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The buoy sank!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It's so heavy! What do I do?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Pull! Pull hard!
They're dead... because of you...
Stop running... Yato...
Because of you...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Argh! W-Why...? It happened so long ago...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Four turns! No more than that!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Look, I was watching this whole time, and it hasn't changed color at all... whoa!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Okay, now it has!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: And now it's burnt...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Your own fault for not listening! You eat it!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: My fault? It's all because you distracted me...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mroaaaw!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey! Stop scratching my horn!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrrow...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Shouldn't you be saving your strength for the Rathalos? Don't let me catch you running away as soon as we get a glimpse.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I told you, I know purrcisely how to deal with the Rathalos. I've noted its weaknesses in my notebook.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's just that your weapons are too weak. Good thing I had the purresence of mind to tell Smithy to meowke stronger weapons.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Rathalos... I wonder what its meat tastes like...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I tell you, Rathalos liver is pawsitively delicious! Nothing is tastier!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: *Huff*...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: —! Who goes there?!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato? Where are you going?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I saw a shadow in the corner of my eye. It went this way.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Who's there? Come out!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I know you're there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Where did they go?)
Meow...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Over there!)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll give you one chance to show yourself.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Approaches slowly)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Show yourself right now!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Meow! It's Yato!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Artisan? It was you?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, it couldn't be... the one I saw was...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Are they gone?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Y-You're too fast...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Did you see something?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yes, but I lost them.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What are you doing here, Arty?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Knocking on meowterials.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You're making... armor and weapons? For the fight against the Rathalos?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Don't touch it!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: No stone! Use this instead!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Is that really something that can be swapped just like that?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Click! There.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Equipment for two!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You want us to put them on?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Purrt them on! Better against Rathalos!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's worth a shot.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Well, I for one can't wait!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...You change over there, Corne.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: How do I... put this on?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Does my arm go through here?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And why is it so...?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I've never... worn anything like this before.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Am I wearing this right? I can't tell.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The helmet's so heavy... and stuffy... is this right?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ouch! And why are there spikes here? They're even longer than my horn.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Is this really meant for wearing?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (The material is light, but surprisingly tough.)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (Arty said they made it using Rathalos parts they brought with them. Not even Yato could cut through it...)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (But something feels familiar about this material.)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (Where have I seen it before? I just can't remember.)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato? I'm done over here. Where are you?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm coming! Whoa—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ow, I hit my head... And now I can't see anything.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Did it go like this? Finally got it on right.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (Looks at Yato)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oh...
Light, swift, powerful.
That's what I always tell people when I talk about this strange new gear afterwards.
'That's not what we were asking about!'
And that's the answer I always get from other operators.
I still don't understand what they mean.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Its showing so much skin... Is this really supposed to be protective gear?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But... I do feel a strange tingling on my skin. And my discomfort from the light is gone.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Look at that, Kirin set!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kirin set? Is that what this is called?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...I suppose I should ask Leizi about it.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Terra meowterial's not bad! Good substitute.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: (Whisper) ...Thanks, Originium slugs.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: My new blades need to be tested in battle... Corne?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you doing on the ground?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I... I tripped. Not used to this new gear.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait, your mask...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I took it off. Doesn't seem like I'll need it to block out the light with this gear, and it's extra weight I don't need.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What... What are you staring at?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Nothing!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Get up. We can't afford to be caught off guard out here. Get used to it quickly.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: O-Okay!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Yato! Noir Corne!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: That strange old man came!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: He took your gear!
